Treat customers and employees with fairness to enable trust
Leadership decisions aligned with personal ethics
Eliminate rules that block customer trust and require workarounds

sections.description: Defines the core idea: growth comes from customers who become your market megaphone, supported by fair treatment of customers and employees.
sections.title: Foundations of a Beloved Company

sections.description: Describes a workplace where leadership decisions mirror personal life ethics and where rules are removed to prevent customer distrust and employee workarounds.
sections.title: Culture of Congruent Leadership and Rule Elimination

summary: In a concise 35-second talk, Jeanne Bliss outlines the core idea of a 'beloved company': growth comes from customers who become your megaphone in the marketplace, which requires treating customers well and also treating employees well. She emphasizes building an environment where leadership decisions align with how you would act in your personal life, and she argues that removing rules that hinder trust or force employees into workarounds is essential to delivering what customers expect without friction.
title: Being a Beloved Company: Growth Through Customer Advocacy and Employee Experience
topics: leadership decision-making congruence with personal life
